theme.referenceNotes: Reference: 6-slide deck on a vertical warm gradient (pink #FC8999/#FE87A5 at top fading to peach-orange #FDAA78 at bottom) with a faint dot texture. Headlines are heavy condensed uppercase grotesk (Anton/Bebas-like -> Oswald 700), very dark navy text (#0D1419), with a light marker block behind the key words. Small uppercase eyebrow with a leading dot, regular-weight sans subline (DM Sans). Text top and centred on slide 1/6, left-aligned on feature slides, bottom-aligned on slide 3. Devices: white/light frame, soft shadow, large and bleeding off the bottom; slide 2 tilted, slide 3 bleeds off the top, slide 5 two overlapping phones, closer has app icon + pill badges + smaller phone. Mapping: kept the vertical light gradient, dark text, condensed uppercase type, marker highlight, dots texture and layout rhythm; swapped the pink top for brand lavender #B9B0FF (matches the app's violet UI) and kept a warm peach bottom #FFB08A so the family resemblance stays; accent = brand #5B4FE0. Text #14112E reaches ~9:1 on both stops.
